text: The paternal grandfather is a Duska whose mother was Maria Demko. Her birth record is believed to be in the Uzhhorod archives and has not been located.
The family comes from Senné and Iňačovce, Michalovce District.
The Duska line has been found in the 1869 Hungarian census and later records, and in a c. 1754 urbarial record where the household kept two beehives.
Kevin leans toward a Rusyn origin for the Demko side and is open to being wrong.
